ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) distribution across approx 98% of visible fluke surface; high-intensity pixels limited to specular highlights and water interface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation mapping across both lobes; small, localized high-intensity pixel clusters observed along the vertical center-line near the peduncle interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth ratio is high relative to the vertical height of the visible lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both trailing edges; significant macro-level irregular indentation (pixel drop-out) on the distal third of the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a slight convex arc from the median notch to the tips; right lobe displays a significant geometric discontinuity approximately 70% toward the distal tip.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of small high-intensity pixel points located on the lower-central region near the peduncle attachment point.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, irregular notch/excision on the trailing edge of the right lobe, departing from the standard serrated topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely high uniform dark pigmentation density across the entire ventral surface, lacking typical mottling patterns found in species-level priors.
